messages:
anya_cs: Heads-up: SlateHealth go-live Thurs. They want a one-page customer opsheet (caching, batching, streaming) + a 3-step renewal play. Keep it copyable and non-technical.

dave_eng: I'll add the tech checklist: prefill steps, batch size suggestion, canary guidance.

sam_sre: Add quick validation cmds (curl health, check x-cache-status, metrics for avg_batch_size).

kevin_se: CS handoff table: prefill tokens, warm pool size, expected cache-hit after 10m.

maria_cs: I'll craft the PDF + short customer email. Will keep troubleshooting checklist: resume vs restart for streams, warmup script snippet, how to collect request_id.

anya_cs: Renewal play (customer-facing): 1) Green: meet SLA & growth -> outreach. 2) Yellow: minor blip -> enablement call. 3) Red: repeated issues or -20% usage -> exec sync within 48h + remediation plan.

sam_sre: Warroom snippet to paste: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?service=slatehealth | jq .`

dave_eng: Preflight checklist bullets for them: run 1k prefix requests to warm KV cache; target batch_size=16 for rwd-medium-quant; run 10% canary for 2h.

maria_cs: ETA EOD tomorrow for PDF + email. I'll post link here for quick review.

anya_cs: Solid. Goal: hand the customer a single-page opsheet + 3-step renewal play at go-live. Keep it copyable. :heart
